reviews.t: not universal! 2 inches in diameter or less, measure your dryer now
reviews.x: Similar to MANY previous reviewers, this diffuser did NOT fit any of my hair dryers: I have three different brands, and the diffuser was just a half an inch small for ALL of them. DO NOT think that you will just get lucky, do the measurements on the hair dryers you own! They should be absolutely no more than 2 inches in diameter. I also find it suspicious that this measurement is nowhere on the product description on the Amazon site or on the packaging box for this diffuser.

reviews.t: Fits snugly on my Hot Shot Tools 2100 Salon Dryer w/ 1.9” nozzle diameter via soft rubber internal grips
reviews.x: This diffuser fits snugly onto my Hot Shot Tools Turbo Ionic 2100 Salon Dryer, which has a 1.9” nozzle diameter. The diffuser has soft rubber grips on the inside that grip the nozzle of my hair dryer securely. The opening for the diffuser measures just less than 2 and 1/8 inches, and I believe would easily accommodate 2” nozzle diameter hair dryers. The diffuser slides on over the nozzle of hair dryers and is held in place by the soft rubber internal grips.

reviews.t: This was a steal at this price!!
reviews.x: Eeeeeeekkk I'm so excited about this!! I love my Dry Bar Buttercup hair dryer, but really wanted a diffuser for it because I like to scrunch my hair time to time. When I added it to my cart, it was $21 I believe. That's still cheaper than Sephora so I was going to get it but waited. SO GLAD I DID. Randomly, it dropped to $12.12!!!! Purchased immediately!!  It fits my hair dryer perfectly. But, I can tell by looking at it that my hair dryer isn't a standard size on the end so I had to purchase th

reviews.t: Better than the one I originally got with it.
reviews.x: This diffuser is amazing. I own a Rusk Speed Freak blow dryer. The diffuser I bought the day I originally bought the dryer is not as great as this Bio IONIC. What's cool is that you can turn the diffuser slightly and control where you want to air to come out. Whether that be like a normal diffuser or have the warm air come out of the "fingers" of it. The fingers are perfect for drying your curls into that spiral formation.

reviews.t: The diffuser to buy for your curls
reviews.x: I researched this diffuser carefully amongst others and decided to go for it. I AM SO HAPPY WITH THIS PURCHASE! My daughter has tight curls and mine are sometimes more of a wavy curl but depending on their mode may be tight. It works beautifully on our hair and fit my conair blow dryer from Target like a glove. I love the way it fit the dryer and feels. I especially love how perfect my curls were after I used it. My last diffuser from the beauty supply store was junk in comparison.

reviews.t: Where have you been all my life?
reviews.x: Best diffuser I have ever had. Fits my Rusk hair dryer perfectly. I love that you can control the air flow. My hair gets dry so fast, the fingers lift to give volume and frizz is controlled. Highly recommend!

reviews.t: Great til it started ripping my hair out
reviews.x: I loved this diffuser til it started catching my hair and pulling it out. I started feeling snags and noticing my curls were losing their shape by the end of drying. Soon every hair drying session was torture and my hair was looking like a mess. I don't use high heat so I can't explain why it suddenly started happening. Went back to my old diffuser and had zero problems. This is going in the trash.

reviews.t: Much better than the typical, ordinary diffuser
reviews.x: This diffuser dried my hair faster than any other diffuser I've owned even with a gentle air flow.  The best thing is that the spokes which stick out make it possible to dry hair next to your scalp without disturbing your curl pattern.  Smart design!  It fit my Babyliss Nano Titanium hair dryer perfectly.  For wavy or curly hair - I highly recommend this.

reviews.t: I purchased this diffuser to go along with the Bio ...
reviews.x: I purchased this diffuser to go along with the Bio Ionic Power Light Pro Dryer my old diffuser did not fit the dryer.  It wasn't expensive so I didn't mind buying it.  It's just ok.  I find it gets very hot even with the dryer on a lower setting.  There is a piece of metal in it that was never in any diffuser I had in the past.  I'm not sure if it is there to help dry your hair faster but I just think it heats up and forces you to move the dryer or burn your head.  BTW the Bio Ionic Power Light

reviews.t: Two Stars
reviews.x: doesn't fit many other blow dryers. Shouldn't be labeled as universal

reviews.t: Doesn't fit (most) dryers
reviews.x: I bought it specifically because so many people were saying it fit their dryers that were my brands. Unfortunately I got it, took it out of the box to look at it, didn't realize my husband threw away the box when I wasn't paying attention, and by the time I got it into the bathroom a day or two later and check if it fit with my blow dryers I didn't have the box to return it. I have three completely different hair dryers, you would think it would've fit at least one? Nope, it didn't fit any of my

reviews.t: Not universal
reviews.x: I bought this after my Deva trained/curly-specialist stylist used it on my hair. It doesn't move the hair at all as it's drying, keeping down the frizz. Slightly deep, to dry more hair at a time.  But sadly this does not fit my "Revlon Perfect Heat" drier. The drier's end has a ridge at the last 1" or so that's smaller than the rest of the nozzle. That last inch fits, but the rest does not, so it won't stay on. This diffuser requires that more than an inch of the drier be inserted, a

reviews.t: I really like it
reviews.x: Arrived a day earlier than expected. This quarantine and lack of a hair cut made me decide to quit hiding my naturally curly hair. The first time I ever used a diffuser on my hair and I am please with it. I like that you can adjust the vents on it. Would recommend this if you need a diffuser to go with your Bio-ionic dry, I have the Gold pro and it fits perfectly.

reviews.t: well made and it fits the hairdryer
reviews.x: Seems to be well made after about 6 uses.  Fits the Rusk hairdryer like it says in the Rusk hairdryer description.  Does fall off the dryer from time to time. Otherwise I'm happy with it.

reviews.t: So happy!!
reviews.x: 10 stars.  Fits my DryBar Blowdryer.  So happy!!

reviews.t: Love that you can adjust the airflow
reviews.x: Love that you can adjust the airflow, one of the main reasons for purchase. Only thing I would change is how LONG/TALL the tallest spikes are. I'd prefer them just about shorter to develop a tighter curl. Literally my only hangup. Great quality, sturdy product, fits the bioionic dryer like a glove fits a hand!

reviews.t: Fits rusk w8less
reviews.x: This diffuser is a good size (not too small) but most importantly, it fits my hair dryer! I have a Rusk W8less dryer and this fits perfectly. It’s a little expensive for what it is, but at least it seems well made like it’s not going to fall apart immediately.

reviews.t: Unwieldy for short hair and small-ish hands
reviews.x: Whoa, this is HUGE.  I found it to be way too bulky for my hand and for my hair.  I have short hair, and it was pretty much useless, but perhaps it might be useful for folks with long hair (and big heads and hands!).

reviews.t: Falls off easily
reviews.x: Initially it connected and stayed on to my hair dryer, no problems. After a couple of weeks, it constantly slips off, so I have to hold it in place while I dry which is annoying.

reviews.t: IF your blowdryer is a match for this diffuser, you are going to want it for lift and volume. Nothing else compares.
reviews.x: Several years ago I had purchased a blowdryer with a similar attachment. I absolutely adored that thing - you could use it on the top of your hair or the sides to give lift so your hair had volume without using any product or doing any backbrushing. The thing was a miracle worker!  Then we entered the era of pin straight hair, and volume and body were out. Thank God, we seem to be passing that era, but hairstyling implements seem to be lagging behind. I was dying to try this diffuser to see if i

reviews.t: great diffuser with a fatal design flaw (and misleading name)
reviews.x: It's probably a very good diffuser, but it doesn't stay on my Bespoke Labs blow dryer. This seems to be a common problem. The device just should not be labelled "universal". I don't even see how it could stay on any blow dryer; there's only tiny little bumps inside of it to cling to the nozzle. Just a fatal design flaw.  I'm using it, reluctantly. I have to use two hands to hold the diffuser on the blow dryer. It's a nice big diffuser with nice long prongs. Too bad about the design flaw.

reviews.t: Good quality, but not universal fit
reviews.x: The quality of this item seemed to be good. I bought it at the same time as buying a bio ionic blow dryer. but i turned out to not like my blow dryer at all so I returned it. I tried using this with my old blow dryer, and it did not fit (even though this claims to be "universal")  It seemed sturdy, and I wish I could have kept it to use with my old blow dryer. TLDR: only fits bio ionic blow dryers

reviews.t: Save Your Money
reviews.x: This attachment doesn't accommodate the width that it claims it does. You will need a hairdryer with an extremely narrow attachment end (less than 2 inches). One of the plastic pieces broke off the first time I used it. There are better options out there.

reviews.t: Great for DryBar
reviews.x: Very happy to find a diffuser for my DryBar hair dryers, both regular and baby bar(travel size).  This fits both sizes very well.  The opening flexes for whatever size hairdryer you need.

reviews.t: Love it!
reviews.x: Fits awesome on my buttercup hairdryer! I love how the amount of airflow is adjustable. Most other diffusers don’t give that option. Perfect size for me!

claims.text: Many reviewers report the diffuser does not fit their hair dryer and criticize the 'universal' labeling.
Several reviewers say it fits their specific dryer (e.g., Rusk, DryBar, Hot Shot Tools, Babyliss) snugly and securely.
Reviewers praise the adjustable vents/airflow control that lets them direct air and control frizz.
Some reviewers report problems: it can catch and pull hair, gets very hot, or falls off the dryer.
Reviewers find it well made and good value for the price.
